# Sample research outputs

**SYNTHETIC DATA - generated by a seeded random simulation, not real market prices.**

Generated by `python scripts/generate_sample_outputs.py --source synthetic` with $10,000 starting capital, 5 bps slippage, next-day execution and a 2% risk-free rate.

Because these come from simulated assets, they demonstrate what the tool produces. They say nothing about real markets. Run the script with `--source yahoo` on a machine with internet access to produce the same files from real data.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| research_report.md / .html | Full summary report (settings, metrics, drawdowns, limitations) |
| equity_and_drawdown.png | Equity curves and drawdowns of the three strategies |
| strategy_metrics.csv | All 12 metrics for each strategy |
| train_test_split.csv | In-sample vs out-of-sample metrics (60/40 chronological split) |
| parameter_search.csv | Moving-average windows ranked by training Sharpe, with test Sharpe |
| cost_sensitivity.csv | Volatility-targeted strategy at 0-50 bps trading cost |
| portfolio_metrics.csv | 60/40 and equal-weight portfolios, rebalanced quarterly |
